IV, 7ᵃ</cite> top <he>קִישּׁוּרֵיה דרב וכ׳</he> the tying of which Rab speaks, referring to tying twigs for the purposes of a tent; <he>קישוריה דר׳ אבא</he> the tying of which R. Abba speaks, referring to tying twigs for the purpose of making an implement (seats); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="S01214"><he>קִישּׁוּרֵי</he></cite>. Bab.
Sabb. 66ᵇ ק׳ Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. קשירי) a sort of stilts, tied to the legs; v. אָנְקִטְמִין.
